text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in what we write. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can read texts in different languages quickly. Another useful function is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and solving problems. Thanks to these technologies, our daily lives are becoming easier and more connected.
